name: Sakura
source:
fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description 

Self-proclaimed bishoujo and [url=https://vndb.org/c6288]Reiji[/url]'s magical weapon. For some reason, she is the only weapon that is allowed outside of Eye Space. Likes animal but animals don’t like her for some reason. Sitting in the sun while dazing off is her daily life.

Clumsy, but a heart warming character that bears the power to destroy an entire planet.

[spoiler]Strangely, Sakura resembles Reiji's dead mother, [url=https://vndb.org/c14471]Yoshino Sakura[/url].[/spoiler]

Summoned by [url=https://vndb.org/c14237]Reiji[/url], Sakura is a "Strategic Destruction Magic Weapon" that uses sunlight-fueled attacks. Sakura is a spirit that takes form of a human girl that is good at both attack and defense by converting sunlight into magic. Although she is a spirit, Sakura is able to fight in battles using her human body to use powerful magic attacks. In addition, because she is an autonomous weapon, Sakura is able to fight independently in battles without her user, Reiji. Her last resort mythical magic shines more dazzling than the sun itself, however, its destructive powers is enough to destroy the world. Therefore, she keeps this power hidden. 

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/10/06/fortissimoakkordbsusvier-final-reviewimpression/]Warum's Review[/url]]

[spoiler]Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

Summonned by Reiji, Sakura is a "Strategic Destruction Magic Weapon" and a spirit of the Sakura Tree who takes the form of a human girl. She is able to use sunlight-based magic in battles, but is weak when she is in the dark and during nighttime. Sakura's main hobby is basking in the sun. Reiji sometimes jokingly calls her a useless weapon for idling around everyday under the sun on the Sagara household's porch. She tends to dote on Maota, a dog she found who once lost his way back home, and the two of them play together frequently now that he is back with his owners.

As a weapon, Sakura's trump card is her "mythical magic". This hidden mythical magic shines more dazzling than the sun itself and its destructive power is enough to destroy one whole planet.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853984]Getchu[/url]][/spoiler]
